name: A Realm of Eternity
detailed_description:
🦄 A Realm of Eternity

In a distant universe lies the enchanting Realm of Eternity, where legendary beings—known as "Eternals"—exist in various forms, personalities, and realms of power. These Eternals, who manifest as captivating waifus and husbandos, have been bound to this magical world by their unique gifts and talents, waiting for the right person to appreciate and cherish them.

Players are known as “Seekers,” individuals blessed with the ability to journey into Eternia and connect with these Eternals. Every click represents a call from the Seeker, gradually deepening their bond with each character and inviting more Eternals into their lives.

Eternals exist across five mystical rarity levels, each with unique traits:

  • Rare: Compassionate companions who bring loyalty and warmth, enhancing the Seeker's experience.

  • Ultra Rare: Mysterious beings who hold secrets and stories that unfold with each interaction.

  • Legendary: Powerful allies from ancient lineages, possessing abilities that inspire awe and respect.

  • Ragnarök: Guardians of Eternia with intense powers and rare wisdom, sought after by every Seeker.

  • Otherworldly: Mythical figures believed to be pure legends, gracing only the most dedicated Seekers with their presence.

🥷 As Seekers, players will

  • Call Eternals to Join: With every click, Seekers reach deeper into Eternia, drawing in Eternals who hear their call. Each character has a unique personality, backstory, and interactive elements that make them a cherished addition to the collection.

  • Strengthen Bonds: Every Eternal added to the collection brings “Glory Points” and personal lore, allowing Seekers to learn about their history, likes, and quirks. These bonds grow stronger over time, unlocking rare items, special moments, and new insights into Eternia’s history.

  • Engage in the Eternal Marketplace: Through the Steam marketplace, Seekers can trade and connect, exchanging waifus and husbandos to diversify their collections and share with other Seekers.

🚀 Join us on the journey

Each Char is inspired by the community on our discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something more awesome!
